help: accept a concept as a headword (merge any aliases into it)

args.name: --all
args.help: accept the whole derived queue (tmp/cache/indexing/candidates.txt) as read — refused if the queue moved since list-candidates wrote it; each candidate becomes its own headword (alias-folding stays per-term work, or edit accepted.txt after)

args.name: term
args.help: the concept to accept as a headword (or --all for the queue as read)

args.name: aliases
args.help: zero or more concepts to fold into the headword
